metadata.title: MedOrbits Internships Database
metadata.description: Structured information on internships, including compulsory rotating internships and optional training. Details are added only from official sources.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify duration, eligibility, stipend and application details with the regulator, institution or hospital before publication.

institutionId.note: Null when the internship is defined by a regulator rather than a single institution.

isCompulsory.note: Null until verified from an official source.

notes.note: Internal reviewer notes; never shown publicly.

dataRules: Every internship record must have a unique id and slug.
courseId must reference an existing course record; institutionId, when set, must reference an existing institution.
countryCode must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
Never invent durations, stipend amounts, eligibility, rotations, dates or contact details; use null or empty values when unknown.
isCompulsory and durationMonths must stay null until taken from an official regulator or institution source.
stipendAmount requires stipendCurrency and stipendFrequency to be set; amounts are plain numbers.
Stipend and internship rules can differ by institution, state and year; always show the academic context in which a record applies.
applicationEnd must not precede applicationStart when both dates are provided.
Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD or null.
Listing an internship does not guarantee a placement, stipend or outcome.
Foreign-qualification internship or observership rules must come from the relevant regulator; never infer recognition.
verifiedAt and verifiedBy must be null until verified, and set together; 'verified' requires sourceUrl.
Expired deadlines and outdated notifications must be reviewed before being displayed as current.
The active field controls display only; it does not indicate that applications are open.

displayRules.unverifiedLabel: Unverified - confirm internship details with the official institution or regulator.
displayRules.disclaimer: Internship rules, stipends and availability can change and are not guaranteed. Confirm with the official source before relying on them.
